Failure mode: Apple rejects mobile monetization/steering implementation for non-US/non-EU storefronts
Mitigation: Ship StoreKit IAP for global mobile. Gate external web link by storefront and entitlement. Maintain App Review note package.
Revisit trigger: Any Apple guideline/news change or first App Review rejection.

Failure mode: Provider TOS breach from treating managed-cloud routing as API resale
Mitigation: Define AGI as customer application, not API resale. Flow down provider terms. Seek commercial approvals before high-volume/enterprise/reseller language.
Revisit trigger: Paid managed-cloud >$5k/mo provider spend or enterprise customer onboarding.

Failure mode: Hobby $10/mo unit economics collapse from long output tokens or agent loops
Mitigation: Hard quotas, model ladder, output caps, BYOK default, abuse detection, budget stop-loss by user/tier/provider.
Revisit trigger: Gross margin <60% for any paid cohort over 7 days.

Failure mode: Prompt caching misses because prefixes are unstable or per-user dynamic
Mitigation: Canonical prompt pack, stable static prefix first, cache key/fingerprint telemetry, split dynamic memory after cached block.
Revisit trigger: Cache hit rate <30% for managed-cloud chats with >1,024 input tokens.

Failure mode: Google cached-context storage TTL creates hidden time-based cost
Mitigation: Default short TTL, garbage collect caches, per-cache budget labels, no persistent caches without explicit ROI.
Revisit trigger: Gemini cached-storage line item >10% of LLM COGS.

Failure mode: On-device model output causes prohibited content without server visibility
Mitigation: On-device policy screen, report abuse, optional safety classifier, no vulnerable-user/high-risk use claims, blocklist for known categories.
Revisit trigger: App-store complaint, user report spike, or app enters youth/medical/legal use cases.

Failure mode: llama.rn instability on device/OS matrix blocks mobile launch
Mitigation: Keep llama.rn as T3 fallback. Require smoke tests on locked hardware. Primary route remains Apple/Android native or RN ExecuTorch.
Revisit trigger: Crash-free sessions <99.5% on local model path.

Failure mode: AICore/Foundation Models eligibility mismatch creates uneven UX
Mitigation: Capability detection, clear fallback order, “local unavailable” UX, separate ASO claims by supported devices.
Revisit trigger: >20% of local-mode attempts fall back unexpectedly.

Failure mode: MCP server marketplace enables malicious tools or supply-chain compromise
Mitigation: Vetted registry default, scopes, OAuth, sandboxing, no auto-install, custom server warning, audit logs, revocation.
Revisit trigger: First public MCP marketplace release or new MCP spec RC.

Failure mode: Privacy-law obligations under GDPR/CCPA/state laws not implemented before public launch
Mitigation: Privacy notice, DSAR/delete/export, retention, consent ledger, subprocessors, GPC handling, EU representative/DPA review if needed.
Revisit trigger: EU launch, >100k users, or any state threshold analysis triggers.

Failure mode: Telemetry captures prompts/outputs/API keys despite privacy-first claims
Mitigation: Telemetry off by default, denylist/scrub at source, event minimization, no session replay on AI surfaces, red-team logs.
Revisit trigger: Any PII/prompt in Sentry/PostHog sample.

Failure mode: Gateway outage/model removal cascades across providers
Mitigation: Own canonical contract. Direct-provider fallback for top three providers. Route health checks and provider budgets.
Revisit trigger: Gateway SLA incident or model availability change.

Failure mode: Provider pricing change with 30-day notice breaks pricing model
Mitigation: Provider-price watch, margin guardrails, model substitution table, user-level budgets, BYOK migration prompt.
Revisit trigger: Any price update notice or >15% COGS increase.

Failure mode: EU AI Act / GPAI / high-risk categorization shifts launch obligations
Mitigation: Avoid high-risk domains and regulated decisioning. Maintain AI RMF register and transparency labels. Legal review for EU app copy.
Revisit trigger: New EU Commission guidance or feature enters employment/education/credit/health.

Failure mode: Prompt injection or tool-call exploit via agentic workflows
Mitigation: Prompt Guard/injection classifier, tool allowlists, confirmation for external side effects, least privilege, audit logs.
Revisit trigger: Public MCP/tool beta or external action integration.

Failure mode: Infra overages from Vercel/Supabase at 100K+ MAU
Mitigation: Traffic/cost dashboards, move hot paths to worker/queue, DB pool/read replica plan, per-service budgets.
Revisit trigger: Monthly infra >10% revenue or DB connection/edge usage saturation.

Failure mode: Consumer app positioning overclaims privacy/local availability on unsupported devices
Mitigation: ASO copy states capability-based availability, not universal offline intelligence. Device gating and disclaimers.
Revisit trigger: App review note or user complaints about offline mode.

Failure mode: Model deprecation/alias change breaks routes
Mitigation: Pin explicit model IDs, maintain migration table, canary new aliases, avoid launch-critical preview/EOL models.
Revisit trigger: Provider deprecation notice or alias change.

Failure mode: DeepSeek V4-Pro promo cliff 2026-05-31 15:59 UTC reverts prices 4x to 1.74/3.48 per Mtok
Mitigation: Auto-reroute past promo_expires_at to V4-Flash or Claude Sonnet 4.6 unless workload-specific quality requires V4-Pro. Embed promo_expires_at flag in models.json. Daily margin alert.
Revisit trigger: Any tier blended margin <60% post-2026-05-31.

Failure mode: Apple Guideline 2.5.2 enforcement against any in-app code-execution UX on iOS
Mitigation: Scope mobile v1 to chat + workflow + remote-controller surface only. Defer code-execution UX to desktop / CLI / web. Revisit post-WWDC 2026 only if sanctioned entitlement ships.
Revisit trigger: Any App Review contact citing 2.5.2.

Failure mode: Chinese-HQ provider routing under EU AI Act Art 50 + US-state ADMT compliance contexts
Mitigation: Default-off DeepSeek/Kimi/Moonshot/Qwen/Zhipu. Per-provider 5.1.2(i) consent + Art 50(1) disclosure. Route metadata flag cn_hq=true triggers extra consent affordance. Legal review of any sales script.
Revisit trigger: Any EU user report of unexpected Chinese-HQ routing.
